description: Opens (or reshuffles) a stateful 78-card tarot session on the Pipeworx original deck, so later random_card/draw_cards/tarot_spread calls with the same session_id draw without repeating a card until the session is reshuffled or expires (24h). Hosted only — a standalone/npm build returns session_supported:false.

seed.description: Deterministic shuffle order. Omit for fresh randomness.

session_id.description: Reshuffle this existing session instead of opening a new one.

name: tarot_shuffle
title: Tarot Shuffle
